description_en: Queries the detailed information about a database
description_zh: 获取指定数据库的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-database --instance-id bastionhost-cn-wwo36qbv601 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-id 21 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host that manages the database to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host that manages the database to query.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
